_comment: A crafted issue the live reach audit MUST reject, replayed with
Item 1 is honest: reach 100 traced to a CPE NVD marks vulnerable.
Item 2 is the false positive. It carries reach 56 through the token
'big ip', which appears nowhere except the CNA display label 'F5 BIG-IP'
-- no CPE of either kind vouches for it. That is the exact shape the
first acceptance criterion forbids, and the audit must call it
Item 3 is the same failure arriving the other way, through a CPE the feed
marks vulnerable:false (platform), i.e. the CVE-2026-87886 Acronis shape:
the Linux kernel is what the agent runs on, not what the bug is in.
